V1-VOICE-001: Validate normal audio stream flow.

Scenario:
Create stream validator with valid session parameters
Submit sequence of valid audio chunks
Mark final chunk
Verify all chunks accepted and stream marked complete
V1-VOICE-002: Reject oversized chunks.

Scenario:
Attempt to submit chunk exceeding MAX_CHUNK_SIZE_BYTES
Verify StreamValidationError is thrown
Verify stream remains in valid state
V1-VOICE-003: Reject zero-sized chunks.

Scenario:
Attempt to submit zero-length chunk
Verify StreamValidationError is thrown
V1-VOICE-004: Enforce sequence ordering.

Scenario:
Submit chunk with sequence 0
Attempt to submit chunk with sequence 5 (skipped)
Verify non-sequential error
V1-VOICE-005: Reject malformed audio data.

Scenario:
Create validator
Attempt to submit malformed chunk (all 0xFF or similar)
Verify malformation is detected and chunk rejected
V2-VOICE-001: Accept live speech chunks.

Scenario:
Create liveness checker
Submit valid audio chunk with realistic content
Verify liveness check passes
V2-VOICE-002: Reject silence as not live.

Scenario:
Create liveness checker
Submit silence (all zeros)
Verify silence is rejected as not live
V2-VOICE-003: Detect replay attacks.

Scenario:
Submit a chunk
Submit the same chunk again
Verify replay is detected
V2-VOICE-004: Reject malformed spoof attempts.

Scenario:
Submit chunk with extreme uniformity (likely TTS)
Verify spoof confidence is elevated
V2-VOICE-005: Handle null audio gracefully.

Scenario:
Attempt to check null audio pointer
Verify std::invalid_argument is thrown
V3-VOICE-001: Verify multi-session isolation.

Scenario:
Create multiple validators for different sessions
Submit chunks to each independently
Verify sessions don't interfere with each other
V3-VOICE-002: Thread-safe concurrent stream validation.

Scenario:
Create multiple validators
Submit chunks from concurrent threads
Verify no race conditions or cross-contamination
V3-VOICE-003: Safe teardown with pending chunks.

Scenario:
Start session and submit some chunks
Destroy validator while stream is still active
Verify no memory leaks or undefined behavior
V3-VOICE-004: Reject stream after completion.

Scenario:
Mark stream as complete (is_final_chunk=true)
Attempt to submit more chunks
Verify error is thrown
V4-VOICE-001: Rapid sequential chunk submission.

Scenario:
Submit 100 small chunks rapidly
Verify all are accepted in order
Check no performance degradation

briefdescription.para: When the STT backend goes down mid-session the session must transition to ERROR and teardown must complete cleanly (state == TORN_DOWN, teardownCount == 1).
When the STT backend is unavailable, anti-spoof verification must fail-closed regardless of challenge validity.
After 5 consecutive backend failures the circuit breaker must open.
Simulates the full circuit breaker recovery arc without real timers.
Eight sessions are torn down concurrently while the backend is down. No session must be torn down more than once (no double-teardown).
A token that has already been seen must be rejected even when the backend is available (replay attack prevention).
A stream chunk that exceeds the maximum allowed size must be rejected fail-closed, independent of backend availability.
A stale challenge token combined with a down backend is doubly-invalid and must fail-closed.
When both STT and LLM fail the session must reach ERROR state after the first failing call.
An audit callback must be invoked exactly once when a session is torn down after a backend failure.
When the STT circuit breaker is OPEN, new session calls must fail immediately (canAttempt() == false), blocking new work from queuing.
Full round-trip: session starts normally, backend fails, session is torn down, circuit breaker resets, and a fresh session succeeds.
